entry.title: Equipment Shed — Yasnaya Polyana

groundCutout.basis: Only occupied equipment-shed footprint; original approaches and neighboring poultry house remain.

buildingCutout.basis: Two adjacent retained one-story shed footprints are candidates for the small gray-gabled poultry house and longer red-hipped equipment shed shown together in the ordinary museum photograph. Sizes and separation support this assignment. The retained long axes are nearly parallel; the photograph may show different faces through perspective/parallax, and no camera position is known. Specific poultry/equipment function and absolute front assignment remain explicit photo/relative-context inferences; the public map names both only as sheds. Use the photographed gray roof on the small building despite the generic map red-roof tag. The larger12.72x6.10m footprint is kept separate from the small gabled poultry house. LocalX southeast is its mapped long axis, with the three-door face inferred at local+Z southwest. Native axes are baked east/up/south, heading0.

terrainReference.basis: Retained Protomaps20261020 and standard Mapzen201x201/6m. Outside garden control[0,5.5774795481570365] gives215.1551128071785m datum. Floor intercept0.3556289698292119m and foundation intercept-0.8778526227228269m, with explicit long-axis grade-.06. Replace only building35184539471090; preserve the independent poultry hut, native courtyard/roads, DEM samples and all ponds. Only the occupied footprint cuts ground; supported aprons seat into original soil. No custom terrain or broad yard flattening.
